steps.what: Open and read the current ophthalmologic teaching procedure and training-model instructions in {DOCS}
Demonstrate the actual ophthalmologic procedure or technique on the training model and explain the clinical reasoning and limitations
Instruct interns, residents, or others in ophthalmologic procedures and techniques by observing and coaching their actual practice on the model
Discuss actual practice limitations and give case-specific feedback and further learning direction

tasks.design: Configure direct current-procedure links in {DOCS} for the teaching session. The ophthalmologist demonstrates, watches actual model practice and provides feedback; software neither teaches the physical technique independently nor certifies competence.
tasks.previous_blocker: Locating the current teaching reference can require repeated navigation.
tasks.enabler_now: Native controlled-procedure links can remove that navigation.
tasks.still_hard: Seeing technique errors and adapting coaching require specialist observation.
tasks.human_edge: The ophthalmologist recognises a movement or judgement error and explains it in context.

ambition.what: No autonomous clinical training or competence decision.

build_days.consent_and_access: 1-4 for teaching-source access and clinical training review; national consultation where applicable

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: direct teaching-procedure links can reduce document navigation while physical clinical coaching remains human.

assumptions: Representative episode is instruction and practice on a training model, not an unsupervised patient procedure. Document owners produce existing controlled references; s1 reads and checks their currency. Missing or unsuitable references require manual preparation, not a free generated procedure.

No competence sign-off, attendance record or report is established by this instruction statement. If the actual programme requires one, split its writing after actual practice and feedback and model the real assessment authority before estimating that episode. No post-training record can be prefilled as completed.

Native links first; existing direct access earns no new gain. No session setup performed once per course is charged to every learner. Resident practice is unchanged baseline participation, not new transferred work.
Shares are provisional active work, not measured training times. Patient-based teaching would require its actual clinical consent, readiness, intervention and supervision work before extrapolation.
research_questions: Does current procedure access leave any repeated navigation during actual teaching?

already_counted.description: Source reading, demonstration, actual practice observation and full feedback remain.

incremental.description: Check teaching links after controlled-procedure revisions.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=98, gross=2; upkeep 0.5 gives net 1.5. Low zero where teaching references already open directly, so add no duplicate configuration. Demonstration, observation and feedback stay intact.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Define and capture the actual retrospective ophthalmology research question, cohort criteria, source mappings and explicit analysis rules in {DOCS}
Read and verify actual eligible clinical source records, resolve ambiguous case inclusion and capture the selected source references and required adjudications
Transfer exact selected existing dates and recorded eye measurements from the {OTHER} electronic clinical record into the restricted {DATA_PLATFORM} study dataset
Run the explicitly chosen descriptive and longitudinal comparisons on the study dataset in {DATA_PLATFORM}
Conduct clinical research in ophthalmology by interpreting the actual tables and original cases, considering bias, uncertainty and limitations
Write and check the actual analysis and interpretation entry in the {DOCS} research working record against original cases and tables
Save the working research entry in the same {DOCS} file without publishing patient data or findings

tasks.design: Configure authorized exact clinical-field transfer and explicit analysis routines in {DATA_PLATFORM}. The ophthalmologist designs the study, verifies source cases, interprets results and writes the research record; no clinical outcome, missing measurement or scientific conclusion is generated.
tasks.previous_blocker: An actual retrospective study may require repeated case-field transfer and repeated execution of selected calculations.
tasks.enabler_now: Native authorized exports and versioned analysis routines can perform those defined operations.
tasks.still_hard: Selection bias, clinical adjudication and the meaning of observed outcomes require expert study judgement.
tasks.human_edge: The ophthalmologist recognises where clinical context invalidates a numerical comparison.

ambition.what: No new research population or causal claim is assumed.

reach.task: Validate ophthalmic study-field extraction and reproducible comparisons
reach.learn: Field provenance, unit consistency and cohort-definition testing

build_days.consent_and_access: 5-15 for actual study authorization, clinical-data safeguards and privacy review; national consultation where applicable

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: exact clinical-field exports and explicit analysis routines can reduce manual transfer and repeated calculation while clinical research judgement remains human.

assumptions: Representative episode is an already authorized retrospective ophthalmic outcomes study with actual manual field transfer and table preparation. It is not a claim about every clinical or laboratory study. Existing clinical staff produce dated eye-measurement records during ordinary care; s1 counts all cohort, unit, date, mapping and calculation-rule capture and s2 counts original-case review, selection and every necessary adjudication.

Exact fields are authorized study identifier, observation date, recorded eye measurement, unit and source reference. Missing measurements remain missing; ambiguous laterality, units or inclusion return to s2. No clean outcome dataset or free recoding is assumed. Any new clinical collection or laboratory experiment requires its actual labour and authority before estimating that different episode.

S3 explicitly performs the transfer into a restricted study draft, not a public data release. S4 performs only specified calculations; native exports and routines are tested first, and existing pipeline runtime earns no new saving. S5-s6 retain all interpretation, original-source comparison and actual research writing.

Same-system save is negligible, minimum share 1 fully retained and ungated without author self-approval. No publication, external dataset transfer or clinical decision follows automatically. Actual ethics/data authorization is an entry condition, not manufactured per-case approval; any new authorization work must be counted before use. Shares are provisional active effort, not measured research baselines.
unknowns: Actual study authorization and data access
research_questions: Which transfers and table calculations are still performed manually in an actual authorized study?

already_counted.description: Study design and capture, complete case verification, clinical interpretation and full research-entry checks remain.

incremental.description: Maintain field mappings and test cohort and calculation outputs after clinical data changes.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=60, gross=40; upkeep 5 gives net 35. Conservative case: inconsistent source fields and atypical follow-up leave only 9 transfer/calculation points avoidable, giving 9-5=4. Clinical case adjudication and research interpretation remain unchanged.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: Less reference navigation and repeated study transfer; clinical coaching and research interpretation remain with the ophthalmologist.
reach: Clinical data analyst: learn traceable ophthalmic field extraction and study-definition tests.
skills_to_grow: Separate analysis runtime from active researcher work
Observe and explain actual technique errors
role.ambitious_version: An ophthalmologist who teaches through direct observation and conducts traceable research with dependable data preparation.
